start: Owner signed in online on a laptop, Today open, a desk person adds a payment on another device

steps.action: Look at the top bar
user_sees: 'Updated just now', then 'Updated 20 s ago', 'Updated 3 min ago'
A 'Refresh' button
must_not: A time that keeps saying 'just now' while nothing was pulled
No Refresh in a browser-only gym shown as broken (it is simply hidden)

steps.action: Tap 'Refresh'
user_sees: 'Refreshing…' with a turning mark
The new payment in Today and Money
'Updated just now'
must_not: 'Updated just now' when the pull failed (it must say 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.')
Two pulls from a double tap
The owner's own unsaved form wiped by the refresh

start: Owner of a browser-only gym (never put online)

steps.action: Add a member and a payment, close the browser, open it again
user_sees: The member and the payment are there
Settings says 'Your gym is saved in this browser only.'
must_not: Anything sent to the gym server
An 'Updated … ago' line or offline bar for a gym that has no server copy
Data shared with another browser profile

start: Owner online; a payment saved offline by the desk was refused by the server when sent

steps.action: Open the panel on the desk device
user_sees: A bar with the member's name and why it was not sent
For the owner: 'Save as cancelled receipt' (when it has a receipt) and 'Remove from this device'
must_not: The refused payment silently dropped
Later things of the same member sent ahead of it
The same buttons shown to the front desk (they see 'Not sent: ask the owner')

steps.action: Tap 'Remove from this device', then 'Yes, remove it'
user_sees: 'Remove it from this device for good? It was never sent, so it will be gone.'
The line goes; '… more things for this member wait with it' are sent
must_not: Removed on the first tap
A receipt number lost with no cancelled receipt when 'Save as cancelled receipt' was the right choice

start: Owner online with a saved copy on the device, Settings > Sign-in & data

steps.action: Read 'Offline copy on this device' and tap 'Clear offline copy' with nothing waiting
user_sees: 'Clear the offline copy on this device? Nothing is deleted from your gym’s records online.'
After yes: 'Offline copy cleared. Your gym’s records online are safe. A fresh copy downloads while this device is online.'
must_not: Any record deleted online
The owner signed out

steps.action: Do it again with 2 things waiting to send
user_sees: A warning that clearing deletes those 2 for good, button 'Delete all 2 and clear'
must_not: Waiting payments deleted without the count being shown

steps.action: Reload the page
user_sees: The gym loads again from the server with the same members
must_not: An empty gym
Old details from the cleared copy

start: Owner signs out on a shared computer; another gym's owner signs in on the same browser

steps.action: Second owner signs in and opens Members, then goes offline
user_sees: Only the second gym's members, online and offline
must_not: The first gym's saved copy or waiting list shown or sent under the second login
A waiting payment of gym A pushed into gym B

start: Front desk signed in, the device has been online once, the internet drops

steps.action: Check a member in and take a ₹1,000 cash payment
user_sees: Bar 'Offline: 2 waiting to send.' 'No internet. Check-ins, payments and new members are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back. Other things wait. Details shown are from <time>.'
A receipt number on the payment
must_not: A success message for something not kept
Payment refused because offline
'Connect this device to the internet once so it can take payments offline.' on a device that was online

steps.action: Tap 'See what is waiting'
user_sees: A list 'Waiting to send from this device' with 'Payment ₹1,000, receipt <no>' and 'Waiting to send'
must_not: Another member's name on the row

steps.action: The internet comes back
user_sees: 'Internet is back. Sending 2 saved on this device…' then 'All sent. Everything saved on this device is now online.'
must_not: A double payment or double check-in online
A different receipt number online than the one given to the member

start: Front desk offline, opens a page that needs the server

steps.action: Open Shop (or Messages) while offline
user_sees: 'This page opens when the internet is back. Open Members to save check-ins, payments and new members now.'
must_not: An endless spinner
A form that takes input and loses it

steps.action: A thing the desk saved offline is refused when sent
user_sees: 'Not sent: ask the owner' on that line
must_not: Remove or 'Save as cancelled receipt' buttons for staff

start: Front desk on a phone, panel open, phone screen turned off for 20 minutes then on

steps.action: Unlock the phone with the panel tab in view
user_sees: One pull at once; 'Updated just now' soon after
Lists show what others changed meanwhile
must_not: Old lists shown as fresh
A pull on every quick tab switch (not again within 15 seconds)

start: Trainer signed in on a phone, online

steps.action: Open the panel and tap the refresh mark in the top bar
user_sees: The mark turns; lists update
Screen reader text 'Refresh. Updated just now'
must_not: More of the gym than a front desk login may see, because a trainer has the desk's access

start: Trainer in the gym basement, no signal

steps.action: Open a member's workout plan page and save a change
user_sees: Either it is kept on the device and listed as waiting ('Change to details'), or a plain line that it waits for the internet
must_not: A saved-looking change that is gone after the internet is back

start: Trainer leaves the panel tab hidden behind another app for an hour, then returns

steps.action: Bring the tab back into view
user_sees: One pull at once; fresh lists
must_not: Server calls made all through the hidden hour
'Updated over an hour ago' staying after return

start: A signed-in panel tab in view, nobody touching it

steps.action: The store runs its repeating check
user_sees: A pull at the set gap while the tab is in view
'Updated …' counts up between pulls
must_not: Two pulls at once when the server is slow
A pull loop after an error

start: The gym server answers a pull or a push with an error, or the session was ended by the owner

steps.action: The store gets the refusal
user_sees: For a dead session: the sign-in page with the reason
For a server hiccup: the saved copy stays on screen and the check tries again later
must_not: The saved copy wiped on an error
A push repeated so the same payment lands twice
A refused push retried for ever instead of being held for the owner

start: The tab is hidden (another tab in front) all night

steps.action: Hours pass, then the tab is shown
user_sees: No server call while hidden
One call when it comes back, unless one ran in the last 15 seconds
must_not: About 124 calls an hour from a forgotten tab (the reason this rule exists)
Urgent alerts lost while hidden (those come by web push, not by this check)
